d:
In what was the final day of the Total Chess World Championship Tour Pilot, Magnus Carlsen took on Vladislav Artemiev one last time. Water spilled, Magnus won, Magnus left - and came back! In this video, we show you all that happened, and two very special interviews with Magnus Carlsen conducted by TV2. A special thanks to Sverre for helping with the translation!
Video: ChessBase India
Shot by: Abhyudaya Ram, Himank Ghosh
Edited by: Himank Ghosh
